decision: The top-level src/capture architecture is removed. Granola provider access and the remaining raw-event compatibility implementation are owned by the Granola meeting-source adapter namespace, while the product core continues to consume only canonical adapter contracts.
implemented_capabilities: Granola HTTP client and provider types owned by src/adapters/meeting-sources/granola
legacy raw-event enrichment APIs retained behind the Granola adapter compatibility surface
product source boundary rejects any reintroduction of src/capture
architectural_invariants: new integrations are introduced under a typed adapter capability
src/core never imports vendor implementations or compatibility APIs
product composition invokes the canonical Granola MeetingSourceAdapter rather than the raw-event poller
historical extraction provenance remains immutable after relocation
